capabilities.name: UI Quality & Interaction Reliability
capabilities.use_via: Feature completion or phase acceptance -> atlas ui review <project-path> -> atlas ui fix <project-path> --dry-run -> optional explicit --safe -> Codex visual recommendations -> human final visual judgement
capabilities.can_use_now: Yes, through the shadow-validated review implementation, evidence-backed visual recommendation layer, and conservative safe-fix planner
capabilities.notes: Use this for UI issue review, evidence-backed visual recommendations, high-confidence mechanical fixes, and the UI closeout workflow. Visual guidance covers action hierarchy, wide-table readability, responsive representation, form grouping, metadata density, and technical-detail disclosure. Safe fixes remain limited to identifiable accessible labels, existing loading guards, bounded fixed widths, and standalone viewport-height safety. Brand, colors, business priority, relevance thresholds, special layout, product taste, and final aesthetic judgement stay project-owned. Atlas does not train or apply automatic aesthetic modification in this capability.
